top_stories.title: 【リリース】claude-code v2.1.330: v2.1.330
top_stories.body:
## What's changed

- Added sign-in to organizations managed in Anthropic's Enterprise Admin Console: after `claude auth login`, Claude Code applies the organization's settings and uses its cloud provider or gateway
- Added easel, a built-in mod that draws charts when asked and under MCP metrics results, on Pro, Max and, where available, Team and Enterprise on macOS and Linux; turn automatic charts off in `/config`
- Added `CLAUDE_CODE_FULL_SIGN_IN_LINK=1` to print the full sign-in link, if the short one shows an error or a script reads values from it
- Self-hosted runner: Added `--start-dir` /

top_stories.title: 【リリース】anthropic-sdk-typescript bedrock-sdk-v1.1.3: bedrock-sdk-v1.1.3
top_stories.body:
### Bug Fixes

* **bedrock:** send the user profile ID in the request body

  Amazon Bedrock reads `user_profile_id` from the request body and ignores the `anthropic-user-profile-id` header, so a profile ID given to `AnthropicBedrock` was not applied. `AnthropicBedrock` now moves it into the body of Messages requests and no longer sends the header. A `user_profile_id` already in the body takes priority over the header.

top_stories.body:
### Features

* **api:** add Claude Code managed settings to the Admin API

### Performance Improvements

* **client:** speed up streaming of large events


### Chores
